data.title: Research V3: common-fold neural comparisons and controlled reduced-input followups
data.body:
This draft extends the reviewed V2 work, merged through #2, with a bounded train-only research campaign. It implements compact TabM and RealMLP-inspired models, AdamW/Muon/EMA controls, exact epoch recovery, immutable provenance, and measured Windows process-budget enforcement. All historical methods, frozen assets, logs and submission records are preserved.

Checkpoint 4adcad21f25bf3c57a9b8b67dbd26b0b1ca200b9 contains 31 completed new configurations / 93 outer fits, with the same nested question folds as 19 verified historical configurations. V3 Attention EMA reaches 1685/2114 hard; pairwise 1684. Neither exceeds historical Attention 1687. Reducing feed-forward inputs raises TabM k4 from1606 to1668 hard and robust RealMLP from1611 to1665; these changes also affect first-layer capacity/initialization. All objective, optimizer, capacity and preprocessing negatives remain in the full table with real costs and hashes. Four tightly bounded reduced-input follow-ups and fixed-seed confirmation remain in progress; no new validation, test score or rank improvement is claimed.

Two preregistered equal-probability mixtures were evaluated and rejected. Actual reciprocal errors justify exactly one further fixed reduced-TabM/Attention-EMA mixture; it has not yet been run. Zero-fit train references were also measured: fixed candidate0 3584/4755, valid-answer majority4054/4755. These are descriptive common-fold references, not trained fits.

Full4755-input Torch/NumPy export checks preserve every choice for TabM k8, reduced TabM k4 and robust RealMLP. The inference contract checks arbitrary N/order/IDs, offline execution and no reference access. Model/loss/optimizer/resume/scheduler and final-delivery boundary checks retain both failures and repairs. Internal independent AI review is not instructor certification.

After research closure, at most two new fixed-base-seed finalists will undergo locked validation. Only one uniquely selected checkpoint can proceed through full resource checks, independent review, fresh public-checkout/new-environment reproduction and one final official test. The original24-hour clock is never reset. Final report, matching immutable code/assets, actual reproduction and submission evidence will replace this progress description before the draft is marked ready.
